given: A clip-first composition has multiple independent clips that can be auto-stitched into the full video.
when: The editor opens the clip list and the user switches between 全部 and one clip.
then: 全部 previews the stitched composition, one clip previews its local timeline, and timeline rows do not show a left-side track description column.

ai_tools.command: NEXTFRAME_HOME=examples target/debug/nf devtools --project v2-showcase --episode showreel-clip-first --query 'nf-clips' --get shadowText
NEXTFRAME_HOME=examples target/debug/nf devtools --project v2-showcase --episode showreel-clip-first --query 'nf-track' --get shadowText
